title: No test file may sit uncompiled under a crate's src
goal: A .rs file under crates/*/src/tests that no mod declares is never compiled: it looks like coverage and provides none. Found by hand three times - the VC-201-041 and VC-201-042 mastery tests that had never run, and a preserved change that was nothing but a registration - each one a test written to protect something and protecting nothing. Check it mechanically: every test file under a crate's src must be declared by that crate, in either the mod <stem>; form or the #[path = "..."] form the crates actually use, and the check runs in CI so a new dead test cannot land.
